visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, sleek dark hair is dancing on a wooden balcony under bright natural daylight. She is wearing a light pink, ribbed crop top with thin straps and a matching mini skirt. She claps her hands rhythmically, her facial expression bright and smiling as she moves her body. The background consists of a vibrant green lawn, lush trees, and a clear blue sky, with a glimpse of the ocean in the distance. (2) The scene cuts to a scenic wide-angle view of a sunlit meadow of green grass. Several medium-sized trees with full green canopies are scattered across the landscape. In the distance, the deep blue sea meets a light blue sky. A white, hemispherical dome-shaped building stands near a paved path. The setting is a peaceful, coastal outdoor environment with high-key natural lighting. (3) The camera moves inside the white dome structure, revealing a spacious room with light grey concrete floors and white curved walls. Two large wooden beds with white linens and blue patterned pillows are neatly made. A small round wooden tea table sits on a circular jute rug in the center. A television and a pale blue, vintage-style refrigerator are positioned against the wall. The camera then shows a bathroom with a modern white sink, mirror, and a tiled floor with a pebble texture. (4) The woman is now standing in front of a large bathroom mirror, having changed into an oversized white short-sleeved t-shirt with a black heart graphic on the chest. She holds a smartphone in one hand to record herself and a pair of chopsticks in the other, using them as a prop while dancing and posing. The bathroom has clean white walls and bright indoor lighting. (5) The scene shifts to an outdoor kitchen area where a second woman in a blue floral dress is preparing food at a counter. A high-angle shot shows a black plate containing a breakfast of green salad, sliced hard-boiled eggs, bread rolls, and grilled chicken. Finally, a white cat with ginger patches is shown sitting on a beige cushion of a dark wooden chair outdoors, surrounded by flowering bushes.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, upbeat electronic dance music (EDM) plays at a moderate volume. The tempo is approximately 128 BPM with a strong, synthesized 4/4 beat. No human speech is present at this moment. The audio texture is clean and studio-produced with no environmental noise. (2) The music volume ducks significantly as a female voice begins narrating in Mandarin. Her tone is casual, friendly, and soft-spoken with a neutral pitch. She speaks at a moderate rate with natural pauses. Background ambient sounds are minimal, suggesting a quiet recording environment. (3) The narration continues with the same female speaker providing descriptive details. Small incidental sounds of movement or camera handling are audible but faint. The BGM remains as a consistent, low-volume melodic layer beneath the clear narration track. (4) A sharp acoustic hard cut occurs. The previous EDM and narration are replaced by a high-tempo hip-hop/trap track. A male singer is heard rapping in Mandarin over a heavy bassline and sharp snare hits. The music is dominant and high-arousal. (5) The hip-hop track fades out, and the original female narrator returns with a joyful, energetic tone. Ambient nature sounds, specifically distant birds chirping, become audibly prominent. A short, high-pitched vocalization from an animal is clearly audible at the end.
